content.value_statement: Manual spreadsheet work can be slow and error-prone. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code create, edit, analyze, and format Excel files.
actual_capabilities: Create XLSX workbooks with sheets, headers, formulas, styles, and number formats.
Read and edit existing XLSX or XLSM files while preserving formulas and formatting.
Build line, bar, pie, scatter, and area charts from worksheet ranges.
Transform CSV or Excel data into formatted analysis workbooks with pandas.
Apply conditional formatting, dropdown lists, numeric validation, and date validation.
Create multi-sheet reports with cross-sheet formulas and summary worksheets.
limitations: Python dependencies such as openpyxl and pandas must be installed before running examples.
The helper scripts do not calculate Excel formulas; Excel recalculates them when opened.
Very large workbooks may require streaming modes or chunked pandas processing.
Untrusted spreadsheets and formula-like input should be reviewed before opening in Excel.

use_cases.title: Create Business Dashboards
use_cases.description: Turn operational data into Excel dashboards with KPI sections, charts, and formatted summaries.

use_cases.title: Prepare Financial Reports
use_cases.description: Generate income statements and sales reports with formulas, currency formatting, and professional layouts.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Workbooks
use_cases.description: Build controlled templates with dropdowns, validation rules, multiple sheets, and consistent styling.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Workbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Excel workbook for monthly sales. Include Product, Units, Price, and Revenue columns with formulas and currency formatting.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze an Existing File
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the workbook named sales_data.xlsx. Summarize its sheets, key columns, row counts, formulas, and any data quality issues.

prompt_templates.title: Transform CSV Into Report
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert sales_raw.csv into a formatted XLSX report. Add a raw data sheet, summary sheet, top products sheet, totals, and charts.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Multi-Sheet Dashboard
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a multi-sheet executive dashboard with source data, KPI calculations, trend charts, validation rules, and a polished summary page.

output_examples.input: Create a Q1 sales workbook with product rows, revenue formulas, and a total row.
output_examples.output: An XLSX workbook with a Sales sheet, styled headers, revenue formulas, currency formatting, auto-sized columns, and totals.

output_examples.input: Transform sales_raw.csv into an Excel analysis report with charts.
output: Raw Data sheet with the imported CSV rows.
Summary sheet with grouped sales and profit metrics.
Top Products sheet with ranked results and a chart.

output_examples.input: Edit an existing sales report and preserve formulas.
output_examples.output: The workbook is updated with new rows and formatting while existing formulas remain available for Excel recalculation.

best_practices: Keep a backup before editing existing workbooks, especially files with formulas or macros.
Use read-only, write-only, or chunked processing for large datasets.
Validate source data and sanitize untrusted values that could be interpreted as formulas.
anti_patterns: Opening untrusted workbooks or macro-enabled files without review.
Replacing dynamic formulas with static totals when the report needs to update.
Processing very large worksheets cell by cell when bulk writes or streaming modes are available.

faq.question: Can this skill create new Excel files?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes examples and helpers for creating XLSX workbooks with data, formulas, formatting, and charts.

faq.question: Can it edit existing workbooks?
faq.answer: Yes. It can load existing workbooks and update cells, rows, sheets, styles, and formulas.

faq.question: Does it preserve formulas?
faq.answer: Yes, when workbooks are loaded without data-only mode. Excel recalculates formulas when the file is opened.

faq.question: Can it work with CSV files?
faq.answer: Yes. The examples show pandas workflows for reading CSV data and exporting formatted XLSX reports.

faq.question: Does it support charts and dashboards?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents chart creation, conditional formatting, KPI layouts, and dashboard-style worksheets.

faq.question: What should I check before using untrusted files?
faq.answer: Review macros, external links, and formula-like values before opening or distributing generated workbooks.
